extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for preparing and submitting a research paper/preprint to arXiv, including allowed file formats, figure requirements, metadata, timing, and replacement procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered-author submissions only
rubrics_metrics.description: We only accept submissions from registered authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must register an account on arXiv before submitting. Unregistered/anonymous submissions are not accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: No omitted figures/tables/sections; no abstract-only submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note that we do not accept submissions with omitted figures, tables or sections. We also do not accept "abstract only" submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such submissions are unhelpful to readers and of very limited archival value. Do not omit essential parts of the paper; include full content in the submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowed text formats (order of preference)
rubrics_metrics.description: Your submission to the archive must be in one of the following formats (listed in order of preference): (La)TeX/AMS(La)TeX; PDF; PostScript; HTML with JPEG/GIF/PNG images.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ArXiv's goal is to store papers in portable, stable formats. TeX/LaTeX is currently the best choice because this open format does not hide information. Note that for this and other reasons we will not accept dvi, PS, or PDF created from TeX/LaTeX source. Users of word processors such as Microsoft Word should save their documents as PDF and submit that. Do not submit scanned documents (scanned PDFs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Figures: accepted formats and recommended uses
rubrics_metrics.description: Figures for a submission can be in a number of common formats. These include: PostScript (PS/EPS, most common for line drawings, plots, etc.); JPEG (ideal for photographic images); GIF or PNG (best for non-photographic images, bitmaps).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If figure files are too large, readers with poor network connections will not be able to download them. If your submission has a large figure, include it but make all possible efforts to reduce its size. Do not omit figures and provide links to another server as a substitute — arXiv does not accept submissions with omitted figures even if you provide an external link. See arXiv information on submission sizes and bitmapping help for more detail. If you have problems with a large submission, contact www-admin@arXiv.org.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include figures with (La)TeX source using standard macro packages
rubrics_metrics.description: If you submit figures with your (La)TeX source, use standard macro packages (e.g., the graphics and graphicx packages) so that the figures will appear in the document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using standard, well-supported packages increases the chance arXiv's processing will render figures correctly. ArXiv administration cannot provide help with TeX-related issues, so seek help from colleagues if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check arXiv response and verify abstract/formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: After you submit your paper, you will receive a response from arXiv. It is very important that you read this response. Be sure to check for errors in the copy of the abstract that appears in the message.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The response to a successful submission will include a URL that allows you to view the PostScript version generated here, together with a username/password for viewing it. If you see any errors or are unhappy with the formatting, you should replace the paper to correct any problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replacement procedure and timing for corrections
rubrics_metrics.description: If you see errors or are unhappy with formatting, replace the paper rather than make a new submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot correct problems yourself, email www-admin@arXiv.org explaining the problem before 16:00 (US Eastern time, EDT/EST). Include the archive and paper number but do not send files/submissions to that address. If you replace before 16:00 US Eastern time Monday through Friday, the archive software will not generate an additional date stamp. Authors are encouraged to update and make corrections; DO NOT make a new submission for a corrected paper or for an erratum—replace the original submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author responsibility for submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Because putting papers on the archives entails certain responsibilities, authors must make their own submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Third-party submissions (by secretaries for example) are often the ones that cause the most problems, presumably due to lack of self-interest and related factors. Authors should personally perform the submission and verification steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required metadata (affiliation and report numbers)
rubrics_metrics.description: The following information is also required for submission: Institutional affiliation for the author(s) must be provided. Official report number(s) from the author(s) institution(s) must be provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete and correct institutional affiliations and any institutional report numbers as part of the submission metadata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Daily availability schedule and embargo rules
rubrics_metrics.description: All archives are on a daily availability schedule, with no activity scheduled on weekends. Each day's submissions are not made available to the general public until 20:00 US Eastern time (EDT/EST) Sunday through Thursday.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timing examples: a submission to hep-th on Monday before 16:00 US ET will be available after 20:00 US ET that day and appear in the Tuesday a.m. hep-th regular mailing. A submission on Friday before 16:00 will be available after 20:00 the following Sunday and appear in the Monday a.m. mailing. A submission on Friday after 16:00 will be available after 20:00 the following Monday and appear in the Tuesday a.m. mailing. Check current local time at the main site for deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact for submission problems
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have problems with a large submission, or cannot correct formatting yourself, contact the arXiv administrators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Email www-admin@arXiv.org explaining the problem (include archive and paper number when appropriate). Do not send files to that address unless specifically instructed.
